body: @shilman I'd like to give this one a shot! 😄

After some debugging, the cause of this is that the MDX components used by the [`Description`](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/blob/6a937b6d032b91c3fbd3ca057a7ee58696a0dcfd/lib/components/src/blocks/Description.tsx#L16) for `code` blocks is different than the one being used by [`DocsContainer`](https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/blob/6a937b6d032b91c3fbd3ca057a7ee58696a0dcfd/addons/docs/src/blocks/DocsContainer.tsx#L19-L24). This causes this difference in styles and behavior when rendering code blocks!.

I have a fix working, I'll do some cleanup and open a PR! I have a concern tho, does this count as a breaking change? as it changes how Storybook behaves for this functionality?

issue.title: Addon-docs: Fix MD code snippet format inside Description

repository.name: storybook
repository.description: Storybook is the industry standard workshop for building, documenting, and testing UI components in isolation

issue.body:
Issue: #13589

## What I did

Changed the styles for how the `Description` component renders code snippets, including inline code, and code blocks with and without language so that it matches the styles used in Storybook `addon-docs` pages.

#### Before:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11748696/113796717-85cf6100-9715-11eb-9b41-bc92b5f6352f.png)


#### After:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11748696/113796512-02157480-9715-11eb-9855-1dc47ab4326b.png)

## How to test

I added a new story so that this **can be tested using Chromatic screenshots**.

body: @shilman I opened a PR fixing this 😄 https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/pull/14495

Yippee!! I just released https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/releases/tag/v6.3.0-alpha.9 containing PR #14495 that references this issue. Upgrade today to the `@next` NPM tag to try it out!

```
npx sb upgrade --prerelease
```

Closing this issue. Please re-open if you think there's still more to do.
